dialogues.speaker: Surikov
dialogues.text: Lemme tell ya... Bachh in the day, I cooud drink shrree bottls o' fire-wahrr, an' bee jussh fine... Jushh fine! That old coot from Morpeshok... What was hissh name again?

dialogues.speaker: Menshikov
dialogues.text: Morepesok? Ah, you must mean Old Lugovskoy... Also, please, cut the drinking and get some water in your system.

dialogues.speaker: Surikov
dialogues.text: Aye, that ol' geezher, rayshed a bear, 'ee did... Shhaw my talents, said I wuzz... *burp* born to hunt!

dialogues.speaker: Surikov
dialogues.text: Took me to shum... birch foressh... I took up mah shingle-shot ruffle... didn't waver, no shiirr! And... BAM!

dialogues.speaker: Surikov
dialogues.text: H—H—Hic the... rabbit, 'course. Grea'shot, that wassh. Rabbit was thish big, and when you bit into it, there was fresh frravur o' grassh, too...

dialogues.speaker: Menshikov
dialogues.text: ...Wait, you hit some Flockingweed, that's all!
